units: Ned. 52ᵇ באתרא דרבנן … ולק׳ ק׳ at the place of the Rabbis (that allow curd to him who vowed abstinence from milk) they call milk ḥelba and curd ḳoma (without any additional qualification) באתרא … לק׳ … ק׳ דחלבא at R. Jose’s place they call curd also the ḳoma of milk; (Y. ib. VI, 39ᵈ top שם אביו קרוי עליה it is designated by its origin).
